system.description: Protected from Missile, Ice and Wind damage. Vulnerable to Piercing and Fire damage.

This attack gains +1 Brk, +2 Atk and +4 Crit for each square that the Grizzly Bear has moved on its turn. On hit, target is Restrained for 1 turn.

Cannot make Extra Attacks. Cannot Counterattack.
When an attack would reduce this unit's HP to 0, if its HP is greater than 1, reduce it to 1 instead.
When HP is half or less, gain 5 Atk and 10 Crit.
